public_rationale: Contemporary developer disclosures acknowledged factual fabrication, and independent code evaluations demonstrated flawed outputs that passed existing tests. limitations: This is an empirical assessment of contemporary general-purpose systems, not a mathematical impossibility claim.
Guarantees for restricted tasks would need to be assessed under their own specifications and assumptions.
